name: Sunday Hotel Arshika Sunset Road
detail: The room is spacious, suitable for a small family, the pool is directly in front of the room, the room is clean, the swimming pool is clean, it is not noisy, and there is hot water.

name: Palette Resort Argya Santi Jimbaran
detail: The room is aesthetic, clean, and has a beautiful private terrace. It is located in a strategic area near Unud Jimbaran and the culinary center. Important notes: Access & Parking: The entrance road (Max Adam) is a bit rocky. Basement parking is limited (only 4-5 cars), so it's highly recommended to bring a motorcycle. Cleanliness: The bathroom was a bit sandy upon entering, perhaps because it hasn’t been used for a while, but other areas are fine. Ideal for those looking for a calm and green atmosphere in Jimbaran! 😉🌿🌳

name: Palette Signature Hotel
detail: Although it's older than the images, the minimum conditions for staying are met. I was concerned about the lack of facilities and the smell of sewage. However, the room was spacious, there was a pool, it was close to the bus stop, and above all, the smiles of the staff were wonderful.

name: Sun Island Hotel & Spa Legian
detail: The hotel is located on Legian Street but is not disturbed by traffic noise. It is close to currency exchange points, convenience stores, cafes, and spas. The pool is relaxing but a bit cold, so I couldn't swim. The staff is friendly and attentive. The downside is that the towels have a strong disinfectant smell, the air conditioning unit is loud, and there are a lot of doors in the hallway that I don't understand the purpose of.

name: Abian Harmony Resort Hotel and Spa
detail: The location is great, but the staff's service is exceptional as well. Starting from reception, everyone is kind and actively helps. Watching the staff help load our luggage into the Grab taxi while greeting us made me think that I would like to come back again. Our room was spacious and comfortable even for three people, making it really nice to relax. I could rest well and was almost reluctant to leave. The only downside was the bathroom lighting. The massages here are also good – I've tried other places too – I went twice during my two-night stay. The breakfast was diverse and delicious. It was a leisurely breakfast by the pool without any crowd.

name: Mamaka Bali
detail: The location is truly fantastic. 12 out of 10 points. You also receive tickets for one free drink per person at the rooftop bar. They don’t even frown if you just order a free drink. There is live music at the entrance restaurant until 10 PM. I thought it might be noisy, but because of the building's design, the rooms are narrow on the beach side and long like a row house, so the sound doesn't reach the rooms, and it was quiet. However, the walls are typically thin like those in Bali, but it's somewhat better than usual. Since it’s located in the center of Kuta, you won’t have any trouble finding food, drinks, or massages. Everything is within a one-minute walk. This hotel is definitely a choice for the next time.

name: Puri Garden Hotel and Hostel Ubud
White Penny Hostel
detail: I stayed for two nights in total, and the hostel is very clean. They clean the restrooms several times a day, and everything is spotless. The beds are very large; perhaps because it's off-season, there are fewer guests, but it's super quiet for sleeping, and my roommates are very well-mannered. The common area has a swimming pool, and there are eight showers for men and women, separated. The hostel offers a rich and varied breakfast, with staples and drinks, which is very delicious. What’s particularly noteworthy is that the staff are really friendly; they greet me whenever we meet, which is something our domestic hostels fall short on. Overall, this hostel has an extremely high cost-performance ratio, and its location is excellent, just a three-minute walk to the beach. I encourage more travelers to give it a try. Next time I come to Bali, I will definitely stay here again.

name: Grandmas Plus Hotel Legian
detail: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Grandmas Plus Hotel Legian This is my sixth time staying here, and I am always satisfied. The room is always clean, the bed sheets are comfortable and still feel new, the air conditioning is very cool, and the shower has strong hot water. The location is also very strategic, so this is always my choice when I'm visiting Legian. But what I like most is the service. All the staff are very friendly and helpful, it feels like receiving five-star hotel service. Check-in and check-out are also quick and easy. Thank you very much to Kak Thia, Alex, and Rias for being so helpful during my stay. The service is really enjoyable. I've stayed six times and will definitely come back again. Recommended! 🙏🏻

name: EDEN Hotel Kuta Bali
detail: I apologize, but my initial impression when I first saw the room was that it was shabby, unlike the pictures! It was clean, but it was an old building with worn curtains and bed sheets. There was a slight leak from the toilet, and although the shower provided hot water, it didn't get very hot (it would be fine for someone who likes lukewarm water). I felt that this was a four-star hotel, but considering the price, the good location, and the spacious room and bed, I was quite satisfied for a solo stay. If your main focus is sightseeing and you don't spend much time in the room, I can easily recommend it. The room was cleaned thoroughly every day. One downside was that the air conditioning was very powerful, and even after adjusting the settings, it didn't weaken much, which was a bit tough for me since I'm sensitive to the cold. There was a balcony with a small drying rack, which was perfect for drying swimsuits and the like. The bellboy was very kind, carrying my luggage to the room and always greeted me when I came to the entrance. The entrance was very spacious, making it easy to call or get out of a taxi. The location was excellent, within walking distance to the airport, Discovery Mall, and Kuta Beach, with several convenience stores nearby, so shopping was not a problem. There were massage parlors both inside and outside the hotel, and I could get treatments right away. I only had breakfast once at the café inside the hotel, but I was able to enjoy a delicious meal for about 500 yen.
